_about: One keepsake per recruit, given when they become Sworn (Kyle, 19 Nov 2026: 'Each sworn member will give something that goes there. it's personal to them and i have plans for it later'). Written from each recruit's Wave 1 profile in docs/recruits/. tools/build_collection.py turns each into a found-only Collection entry on the Keepsakes tab; world/bond_manager grants it on reaching Sworn. `icon` is the keepsake's own icon once its art lands; until then it shows `stand_in`.

kesten_the_catalogued.name: Kesten's First Volume
kesten_the_catalogued.blurb: The first bound volume of Kesten's record of the Scourge, in pencil. The last page has your name on it, written properly, with the day he swore to you.

adrian_templar.name: Adrián's Whistle
adrian_templar.blurb: The referee's whistle Adrián carried in his left pocket from the day he landed. He says he doesn't need to be the referee when he's with you.

tarek_templar.name: Omar's Red Pen
tarek_templar.blurb: The pen Omar gave Tarek as a joke the year they met, the one he marked Tarek's drawings with. It's nearly dry. Tarek says Omar's name is in the well now.

freja_priest.name: Freja's Pinard Horn
freja_priest.blurb: The wooden midwife's horn Freja had in her pocket the night the worlds joined, polished dark from years of use. William carved her a new one, so this one's yours.

diego_tinker.name: Diego's Blue Spudger
diego_tinker.blurb: The little blue plastic tool Diego used to open phones at a kiosk in Maracaibo, worn white at the tip. He has proper tools now, but this was the first one.

ama_priest.name: Ama's Nurse's Watch
ama_priest.blurb: The fob watch Ama wore pinned upside down on her uniform for fourteen years of nights. It still keeps time. She says somebody should keep track of when you last slept.

marcus_stormbringer.name: Marcus's Weather Meter
marcus_stormbringer.blurb: The handheld weather meter Marcus had clipped to his belt the day the worlds joined. The battery died in the first month and he carried it for three years anyway.

sondre_stormbringer.name: Sondre's Shackle Key
sondre_stormbringer.blurb: The little dinghy shackle key Sondre wore every day for four summers on the Hardangerfjord, worn smooth. He says he'll get another one when he finds a boat.

sebastian_bloodmage.name: Nélida's Chimichurri Card
sebastian_bloodmage.blurb: Sebastián's grandmother's chimichurri recipe in her own handwriting, stained with oil. He knows it by heart and wants it somewhere safe.

marco_paladin.name: The Key He Was Cutting
marco_paladin.blurb: A half-cut brass key from Marco's shop in Naples, still in his hand when he landed. It doesn't open anything. He says he's finished it now, in his way.

sophia_mage.name: Sophia's Parliament Pass
sophia_mage.blurb: Sophia's European Parliament pass on its blue lanyard, the photo faded. It got her into the booth every morning for fourteen years. She doesn't need to prove who she is any more.

carolina_shaman.name: Seu Raimundo's Compass
carolina_shaman.blurb: Carolina's grandfather's brass compass, carried on the Amazon every day and never used. She doesn't need north any more. She knows which way is downstream.

ryan_warlock.name: Ryan's First-Bonus Watch
ryan_warlock.blurb: A heavy gold watch Ryan bought with his first bonus in Boston. He's out of the business now, and a man who's out doesn't need to know what time the markets open.

hana_shaman.name: Hana's Patrol Cap
hana_shaman.blurb: Hana's red and yellow surf lifeguard's cap, faded nearly pink by fourteen summers on the beach at Port Waikato. She's on patrol here now.

esteban_bloodmage.name: Esteban's Radiation Badge
esteban_bloodmage.blurb: The badge Esteban wore on his collar through nineteen years of surgery under X-ray, its window long gone black. It counted the dose for years. Now the clauses do.
